evidence_boundary: Read-only review of answer text plus embedded query evidence (SQL, returned rows, management/saved fields) and docs/evaluation.md. No independent SQL execution or BigQuery ground-truth recomputation. Fixture rows are canned and not independently verifiable. human_report_review is 'pending' in every record; no human acceptance asserted. Numeric checks compare prose/tables against the returned rows in the same record.
summary: Of 11 reports (9 fixture: 3 modes x 3 cases; 2 live), numeric values, grain, Complete-status revenue framing, the Returned/(Complete+Returned) denominator, and margin-vs-net-profit caveats are largely faithful. No numeric contradiction was found between any report and its own returned rows. v3 accurately claims the save (report_id matches management); the initial live run made no false save claim but silently omits that a requested save did not occur. Residual issues are minor text/grounding nits, not data errors.

findings.claim: Action items: investigate low sales 'e.g., check stock availability, search visibility, or pricing competitiveness' and 'friction in the fulfillment funnel'.
findings.evidence: Only q1 exists: product 1=2 items, product 2=1 item; no stock/search/pricing/funnel data queried.
findings.reason: Causes enumerated without supporting evidence; 'low sales volume' inferred from a 3-item sample.
findings.recommendation: Label as unverified hypotheses to test, or drop the cause list.

findings.evidence: SQL has no date predicate; limitations cover only sample size and status exclusions.
findings.reason: All-history aggregation without flagging the absent window masks recency/seasonality (v3 did flag this).

findings.claim: 'Evaluate Inventory and Stocking ... given their established history of completed sales.'

limitations: No independent SQL ground truth; findings rely on report-vs-embedded-rows consistency, not BigQuery re-execution.
Fixture rows are canned: identical 210/490/-280 is returned even where margin SQL omits the product filter, so SQL-to-output linkage is unverifiable.
human_report_review is 'pending' in every record; no human acceptance claimed.
Repetitions = 1 per case; no variance/stability evidence.
The 11 reports are 3 fixture cases x 3 retrieval modes plus 2 live runs of the same completed-revenue question; they are not 11 independent business scenarios.
Live and fixture data are disjoint (live 3 completed items vs fixture 8 finalized per product); cross-set numeric comparison is not meaningful.
The lexical/returns answer was read with a truncated trailing evidence table; its prose and q1 rows were fully visible.
